ceiling_reading_threshold_note: loadgen_saturated at busy_pct_mean >= 95, near_saturation >= 80. A saturated load generator does NOT bound the result, it INVALIDATES it: the measurement then describes how fast the driver can offer requests, not how fast the target can serve them. Unlike the DB ceiling, no comparator survives this — discard the leaf.

sampler_meta.note: Load generator (wrk) CPU over the measurement window. Read it as a CEILING CHECK, not as a cost: a closed-loop throughput number is an application measurement only while the generator has headroom. If busy cores approach the pin width, the arm was generator-bound and the rps figure is a floor, not a result.
